rule.description: The query formatter type (TrackedBuffer) owns, besides its native AST-to-template formatting responsibility, two or more foreign query-emission concerns (bind-variable materialization, literal redaction, impossible-query shadow emission) simultaneously. A type is the formatter type when it declares Myprintf, WriteArg or WriteNode; a method joins a foreign concern cluster when it directly references querypb.BindVariable (bindvar materialization), calls the package-level Normalize function (literal redaction), or contains the string literal '1 != 1' (impossible-query emission), or delegates to another method of the same type that does.

checks.description: TrackedBuffer, the project's query formatter, has accumulated two or more distinct foreign query-emission concerns beyond its formatting responsibility, satisfying the god-class condition.
checks.detected_relation: formatter type TrackedBuffer -> foreign concerns {bindvar_materialization, literal_redaction, impossible_query_emission}
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Formatting a SQL template, resolving/encoding supplied bind vars, redacting literals for display, and emitting a zero-row shadow query are separate responsibilities that change for different reasons; centralizing them on the one buffer type that renders node trees obscures ownership and couples unrelated maintenance.

matches.evidence: Builder that cements the bind-variable namespace onto the formatter type; references querypb.BindVariable.
Drives bind-variable substitution into the formatter's own buffer by delegating to ResolveBindVar/EncodeBindValue.
Resolves bind names against the formatter's own namespace; references querypb.BindVariable.
Encodes a supplied bind variable into the formatter's own buffer; references querypb.BindVariable and sqltypes value helpers.
Renders a redacted statement through the formatter by calling Normalize with the formatter's redact prefix and namespace.
Writes a zero-row shadow query from the formatter; its body carries the '1 != 1' where clause.

excluded.reason: Native formatting primitive; defines the formatter identity rather than a foreign concern.
Native template-formatting and bind-location bookkeeping of the formatter; not foreign query-emission concerns.
Plain string setter referencing no foreign concern marker directly and delegating to nothing foreign; not credited as a match.
Own at most one concern cluster in the clean or injected tree and do not declare the formatter primitives, so the rule does not flag them.
